case_title: BUDNIK SOL VS SEQUOIA NATIONAL BANK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $600.00 FILED BY BUDNIK SOL AS TO DEFENDANT SEQUOIA NATIONAL BANK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-16-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 06
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SEQUOIA NATIONAL BANK

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BUDNIK SOL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SEQUOIA NATIONAL BANK PLAINTIFF IS BANNED FROM FILING ANY FURTHER CLAIM RELATED TO THE FACTS GIVING RISE TO THIS CASE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
